overall_summary: The channel has low overall views with high variance. Content focused on 'self respect' with micro-interactions (like deleting chats, changing settings, blocking/unblocking) performed moderately better in early September (e.g., AfaLxMy6FMY with 41 views, rwOUYo_hayQ with 41 views), but recent videos on similar digital boundaries have flattened out. Confidence is low because sample sizes are small and views fluctuate randomly.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on specific phone actions like deleting chats or status lists (e.g., AfaLxMy6FMY, rwOUYo_hayQ) hit higher views (~41) compared to abstract loneliness.
winning_patterns.action: Continue anchoring stories around tangible, everyday digital or physical boundary moments related to self-respect.

weak_patterns.evidence: Recent posts about unpinning, custom ringtones, and keyboard history (published Sep 17-19) consistently stagnated under 10 views.
weak_patterns.action: Pause repetitive ringtone/keyboard tropes and shift slightly toward offline, physical manifestations of self-respect.
